name: Atelier
tagline: A plaster-toned studio page whose oversized Bodoni headline is lit letter by letter by a slow diagonal sweep, above a pointer-draggable strip of CSS-drawn case studies.
sections: Nav with brand, four links and an outlined action
Hero with the light-swept display headline, a 30-ch lede, one filled CTA and an availability note
Selected work strip: six case studies with CSS-drawn plates, scroll-snap and mouse drag
Process as a four-stage ruled calendar (Weeks 1–2 to Week 10)
Studio statement: client quote beside a definition list of studio facts
Three engagement formats as ruled rows with price, duration and a button
Final call to action on ink with a mailto
